integrity: Complete mathematical proof and reproducible independent direct finite enumeration; verification is finite and not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite independent-edge random graphs only; 3 <= r <= |V(H)|, |V(H)| >= 3, n >= |V(H)|+r-2. Asymptotics hold for fixed pattern and clique size. No claim of stochastic independence, fixed-edge extension, or historical-priority certification.
title: A universal single covariance sign switch between clique counts and induced graph patterns
